title: calanthe labiata
intro: Calanthe labiata, commonly known as the "labiate orchid", is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Calanthe labiata include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infectious diseases, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids and phenolic acids. These constituents have been shown to exhibit immunomodulatory, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities, making Calanthe labiata a potential source of novel medicines.
